title: Real-Time Measurement Dashboard — Overview and definition
t: Real-Time Measurement Dashboard — Overview and definition
description: Streams live instrument readings into operator dashboards with alarms.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Streams live instrument readings into operator dashboards with alarms. A real-time measurement dashboard subscribes to instrument and DAQ streams, renders gauges, trends, and histograms at display rate, and raises visual and audible alarms on limit violations. Real implementations use Grafana with streaming plugins, Node-RED dashboards, and LabVIEW front panels. It downsamples intelligently so a 1 MS/s stream still renders smoothly on a phone.
capabilities: Live gauges, strip charts, and histograms from streaming sources
Alarm limits with hysteresis, shelving, and acknowledgment
Intelligent downsampling (min/max buckets) for fast streams
Layout persistence per operator and per test campaign
Recording of dashboard sessions for post-test review
